lines.en: label harukainvite1:
I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Haruka 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: I’ve been to her place several times now, so I figure it’s about time to show her the same sort of hospitality she’s shown me.
lines.zh: 我已经去过她家好几次了，所以觉得是时候也招待她一次，就当回敬她对我的款待。

lines.en: That and I feel kind of bad since she’s always talking about how lonely she is and whatnot.
lines.zh: 再说，她总说自己有多孤独什么的，我也有点过意不去。

lines.en: But hey, we’ve been gradually getting closer with one another lately.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我们最近确实在一点点走近。

lines.en: And she’s one of the few people I know that I don’t feel strange about being seen in public with.
lines.zh: 而且她是我认识的人里，为数不多让我被看见和她在一起也不会觉得别扭的。

lines.en: Sure, Ami will likely react the same way she reacted when Sara came over for the first time, but it’s not like I’m going to just avoid everyone because of that.
lines.zh: 当然，Ami 大概会像 Sara 第一次来时那样反应，可我也不至于因此就躲着所有人。

lines.en: Besides, Ami and Sara {i}did{/i} get along by the end of that visit.
lines.zh: 再说了，那次拜访结束时，Ami 和 Sara 也{i}确实{/i}处得不错。

lines.en: I’m sure something similar will happen with Haruka.
lines.zh: 我相信 Haruka 这次也会有类似的结局。

lines.en: : Hey! What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿！怎么啦？

lines.en: : Hey, Haruka. Do you have any plans tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Haruka。你今晚有安排吗？

lines.en: : Does eating an entire pint of ice cream count as a plan?
lines.zh: : 干掉一整品脱冰淇淋算安排吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不算，真不算。

lines.en: : Then I’m totally free. Why?
lines.zh: : 那我完全有空。怎么了？

lines.en: : Do you want to hang out?
lines.zh: : 你想一起玩吗？

lines.en: : I do. How would you feel about coming over to my place for a change?
lines.zh: : 想。换个方式，来我家怎么样？

lines.en: : Your place? Isn’t that on like, the opposite side of town?
lines.zh: : 你家？那不是在，怎么说，镇子的另一头吗？

lines.en: : Don’t you have a car?
lines.zh: : 你不是有车吗？

lines.en: : Yeah but...gas.
lines.zh: : 有是有，可是……油钱。

lines.en: : That sounds like a very minor struggle compared to me taking the bus to your place all the time.
lines.zh: : 比起我一直坐公交去你家，这点困难听起来微不足道啊。

lines.en: : Then you should get a car, too!
lines.zh: : 那你也该买辆车！

lines.en: : But...gas.
lines.zh: : 可是……油钱。

lines.en: : Hahaha~ Okay, okay. I’ll come over.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈~ 好啦好啦。我去。

lines.en: : Can you text me the address?
lines.zh: : 你能把地址发给我吗？

lines.en: : Sure thing. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 当然。一会儿见。

lines.en: : Yup! See you!
lines.zh: : 嗯！一会儿见！

lines.en: I hang up and immediately type out my address to Haruka, who responds with a quick thumbs-up.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，立刻把地址打给 Haruka，她很快回了个大拇指。

lines.en: From this point on, the night becomes a mission with the objective of only partially ruining Ami’s life rather than full on destroying it.
lines.zh: 从这一刻起，今晚就变成了一场任务，目标是「部分地」毁掉 Ami 的生活，而不是彻彻底底地摧毁它。

lines.en: scene black
You see...in her eyes, each new woman that shows up is another obstacle separating the two of us.
lines.zh: 你看……在她眼里，每一个出现的新女人，都是又一道把我俩隔开的障碍。

lines.en: And, in addition to being much closer to my age, Haruka possesses one other thing that is sure to set Ami off almost immediately.
lines.zh: 而且，除了年龄上更接近我之外，Haruka 还有一样东西，几乎必定会立刻把 Ami 点着。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite1
: Your boobs really {i}are{/i} huge, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你的奶子{i}真的{/i}大啊，Haruka。

lines.en: : Dude. What kind of greeting is that?
lines.zh: : 老兄。这算什么开场白？

lines.en: : You haven’t even said hi yet.
lines.zh: : 你连句「嗨」都还没说呢。

lines.en: : Sorry. I wanted to, but it’s been getting a lot harder keeping my thoughts to myself lately.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我本来想说的，可最近越来越难把想法憋在心里了。

lines.en: : That sounds like something that could get you into serious trouble someday.
lines.zh: : 这听起来像是哪天会给你惹上大麻烦的事。

lines.en: : Like, what if I got super offended by that and stormed out of here?
lines.zh: : 比如，要是我被这话严重冒犯，气冲冲地摔门走了呢？

lines.en: : Would you have preferred if I called them small?
lines.zh: : 那我说它们很小，你会更乐意？

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite2
: I would have preferred if they were never the conversation topic to start off with.
lines.zh: : 我更希望它们从一开始就没成为话题。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I think I’m starting to see the issue.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我觉得我开始明白问题在哪了。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite3
: I sure hope so. I kind of directly pointed it out for you.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此。我可是直接给你点出来了。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to stare, which you’ve...very obviously been doing this entire time, but coming out and talking about them isn’t exactly polite.
lines.zh: : 盯着看是一回事——你这一整晚显然都在盯着看——但直接开口谈论，可就不太礼貌了。

lines.en: : Like, you don’t see me walking in and being like “Wow...Your shoulders are so broad and you’ve got the figure of an ancient roman warrior.”
lines.zh: : 你看，我也没有一进门就说「哇……你肩膀好宽，身材像古罗马战士」吧。

lines.en: : “And your hands look like the perfect size for...grabbing a girl by her wrists and...”
lines.zh: : 「而且你的手大小正合适，适合……抓住女孩的手腕，然后……」

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite4
: Yeah I’m just gonna stop talking before I say something else that makes me sound like a creep.
lines.zh: : 算了，我闭嘴吧，免得再说出什么让我听着像个变态的话。

lines.en: : Looks like I’m not the only one having trouble keeping my thoughts to myself.
lines.zh: : 看来不是只有我一个人憋不住想法。

lines.en: : I spend so much of my time inside the cafe that I’m beginning to struggle in the outside world.
lines.zh: : 我在咖啡馆里待的时间太长，搞得我在外面的世界里开始不太行了。

lines.en: : I think it might be time for an intervention or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可能该有人来干预我一下什么的。

lines.en: : Please save me from myself, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 求你把我从我自己手里救出来吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : Uhh, sure.
lines.zh: : 呃，好啊。

lines.en: : Where do you want to start?
lines.zh: : 你想从哪儿开始？

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite5
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : Do you not have a plan or anything for tonight?
lines.zh: : 你今晚没有计划什么的吗？

lines.en: : I've gone to your house a bunch of times and {i}you've{/i} never had a plan. We always just sit there and watch TV.
lines.zh: : 我去你家那么多次，{i}你{/i}从来都没有计划。我们每次都只是坐在那儿看电视。

lines.en: : Duh. That’s my default setting.
lines.zh: : 废话。那是我的默认设置。

lines.en: : If nobody drags me out of the house, I’ll just do that every day for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 要是没人把我从家里拽出去，我就会这么过一辈子。

lines.en: : I kind of need somebody to lead the way or I’ll turn into a giant, pink blob who can recite all nine seasons of The Office by heart.
lines.zh: : 我得有个人带路，不然我会变成一坨巨大的粉色肉球，能把《办公室》全九季倒背如流。

lines.en: : That show isn’t even funny.
lines.zh: : 那剧根本不好笑。

lines.en: : The only people who say that are contrarians or those who think they’re somehow too good for it because it doesn’t appeal to their {i}superior intellect{/i}.
lines.zh: : 会这么说的人，要么是抬杠的，要么是觉得自己格调太高、那剧配不上他们的「{i}超凡智商{/i}」。

lines.en: : This sounds like a topic you feel very strongly about.
lines.zh: : 听起来你对这个话题很有执念啊。

lines.en: : I’m tired of people pretending The Office isn’t funny. They should all die.
lines.zh: : 我受够了那些假装《办公室》不好笑的人。他们都该去死。

lines.en: : Okay, well anyway...I guess we can just watch TV since that seems to be the entirety of your comfort zone.
lines.zh: : 好吧，总之……既然看电视似乎就是你的整个舒适区，那我们就看电视吧。

lines.en: : But there is something I should warn you about beforehand.
lines.zh: : 不过有件事我得先提醒你。

lines.en: : You don’t have one of those doors that I’m not supposed to open under any circumstance, do you?
lines.zh: : 你家里不会有那种「无论如何都不许打开」的门吧？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？没有。

lines.en: : Why would you assume that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会这么想？

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite6
: If there’s anything I’ve learned from all that time I’ve spent in my “comfort zone,” it’s that the people you {i}don’t{/i} expect to have secret doors are always the ones that actually have them.
lines.zh: : 如果说我窝在「舒适区」里那么久学到了什么，那就是：你最想{i}不{/i}到会有暗门的人，往往才是真有的那些。

lines.en: : But...I guess you seem kind of like you’d have one. So that means there shouldn’t be one here after all.
lines.zh: : 不过……我觉得你看起来像是会有的那种人。那就说明这儿应该没有。

lines.en: : Did you make the insult extremely elaborate on purpose or was that just accidental?
lines.zh: : 你是故意把这句骂人的话设计得这么绕，还是不小心？

lines.en: : A mixture of both, I guess?
lines.zh: : 大概两者都有吧？

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite7
: So, what’s the thing you need to warn me about?
lines.zh: : 那你要提醒我的是什么事？

lines.en: : You’re not just renting this place out from some creepy old guy who’s going to walk out of his room in nothing but his boxers, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是从某个猥琐老头手里租的这地方，而他会只穿条四角裤从房间里走出来吧？

lines.en: : Again with the strange assumptions...
lines.zh: : 又是这些奇怪的假设……

lines.en: : The warning is that I’m not sure where my [niece] is today and she could come home at any moment.
lines.zh: : 我要提醒的是，我不确定我的[侄女]今天在哪儿，她随时可能回来。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite8
: Then why didn’t we just chill at my place?
lines.zh: : 那我们干嘛不干脆在我家待着？

lines.en: : I’m going to feel really awkward if she just comes in and sees us hanging out when I’ve never even met her before.
lines.zh: : 我连她面都没见过，要是她就这么进来撞见我们在一起，我会很尴尬的。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite9
: Who are you and why are your boobs so big?!
lines.zh: : 你是谁，还有你的奶子为什么这么大？！

lines.en: : See? This is totally weird for me now.
lines.zh: : 看吧？现在我觉得超尴尬了。

lines.en: : Ami, this is Haruka. She’s a friend of mine.
lines.zh: : Ami，这是 Haruka。她是我的朋友。

lines.en: : That still doesn’t answer the second question!
lines.zh: : 这还是没回答第二个问题！

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite10
: Is mentioning the size of someone’s chest a thing your entire family just...does for some reason?
lines.zh: : 点评别人胸部的尺寸，是你们全家不知道为什么……都会干的事吗？

lines.en: : I guess. But I do it out of interest and Ami does it out of jealousy.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过我是出于兴趣，Ami 是出于嫉妒。

lines.en: : People like you make me sick...
lines.zh: : 你这种人真让我恶心……

lines.en: : Using their bodies to seduce my [uncle] when everyone is FULLY AWARE that he likes smaller girls like me!
lines.zh: : 用身体勾引我的[叔叔]，可所有人都心知肚明，他喜欢的是我这样平胸的女孩！

lines.en: : Really? Is that true?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？是这样吗？

lines.en: : Yes! The smaller, the better!
lines.zh: : 没错！越小越好！

lines.en: : Okay, moving right along.
lines.zh: : 好了，这个话题跳过。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite11
: I don’t think she likes me very much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不太喜欢我。

lines.en: : She’s like an animal. She’ll warm up to you the more she sees you.
lines.zh: : 她就像小动物。见你多了就会跟你亲近起来。

lines.en: : I’ve seen her plenty of times. That’s the cafe lady.
lines.zh: : 我见过她好多次了。那是咖啡馆的大姐姐。

lines.en: : Rin always talks about how great her boobs are.
lines.zh: : Rin 总说她的奶子有多棒。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite12
: Okay, people seriously need to find other things to say about me. This is getting obnoxious.
lines.zh: : 好了，大家真的该找点别的事来说我了。这越来越烦人了。

lines.en: : At least none of them are hiding their true feelings.
lines.zh: : 至少他们都没藏着自己的真实想法。

lines.en: : I kind of wish they would.
lines.zh: : 我倒是希望他们藏一藏。

lines.en: : Though, it {i}is{/i} nice hearing that secondhand affirmation from Rin. Thank you, Sensei’s [niece].
lines.zh: : 不过，能间接听到 Rin 的夸奖还{i}是{/i}挺开心的。谢谢你了，Sensei 的[侄女]。

lines.en: : She doesn’t even know my name...
lines.zh: : 她连我名字都不知道……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’ve told it to her before.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我之前跟她说过。

lines.en: : She’s likely just being rude to you since you’re being rude to her.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是因为你对她没礼貌，才对你没礼貌。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite13
: What ever happened to Sara?! She was much nicer to me and her boobs were way smaller!
lines.zh: : Sara 后来怎么样了？！她对我友善多了，而且她的奶子小多了！

lines.en: : Did you cast her aside for a discount on coffee?! We have coffee at home!
lines.zh: : 你为了咖啡打折就把她甩了？！我们家里有咖啡！

lines.en: : Sara’s been here already?
lines.zh: : Sara 已经来过这儿了？

lines.en: : Yeah, I invited her over a while back.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我前段时间请她来过。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Ami, if you want to see Sara, you can just go visit her at the bar.
lines.zh: : Ami，你要是想见 Sara，直接去酒吧找她就行了。

lines.en: : And do what?! Drink Shirley Temples and talk about what things were like in the old days?!
lines.zh: : 去干什么？！喝秀兰邓波儿，然后聊从前是什么样子？！

lines.en: : I’m not even old enough to drink, jerk!
lines.zh: : 我还没到能喝酒的年纪呢，混蛋！

lines.en: : Then go with Molly. That’s never stopped her.
lines.zh: : 那就跟 Molly 一起去。她可从来没被这事拦住过。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite14
: She’s off today, so you probably could.
lines.zh: : 她今天休息，所以你大概真能去。

lines.en: : Molly got paid this week and I’m pretty sure Sara wouldn’t mind selling to anyone underage as long as it meant profit for her.
lines.zh: : Molly 这周刚发了工资，而且我敢肯定，只要能赚钱，Sara 是不介意卖酒给未成年人的。

lines.en: : I appreciate the tip but I don’t even like alcohol and I definitely do not feel safe leaving your awesome boobs alone with my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的提示，可我根本不喜欢喝酒，而且我绝对不放心把你这对了不起的奶子单独留给我[叔叔]。

lines.en: : Wow...[teenage]girl chest-envy really is alive and well, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇……[teenage]女孩的胸部嫉妒还真是活得好好的啊？

lines.en: : It’s a shame, too. You’re such a cute girl.
lines.zh: : 也挺可惜的。你这么可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : Having boobs this size would make your proportions all weird and your [uncle] probably wouldn’t even talk to you anymore.
lines.zh: : 要是胸部这么大，你的身材比例会变得很奇怪，你[叔叔]大概都不愿意理你了。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite15
: M-My proportions would obviously change along with them!
lines.zh: : 我……我的比例当然也会跟着一起变啊！

lines.en: : Nobody gets huge boobs without...the rest of their body growing, right?!
lines.zh: : 没有人长了巨乳，身体其他地方却……不跟着长的，对吧？！

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite16
: But...wait. Uta’s boobs are still growing and she’s even shorter than me...
lines.zh: : 可是……等等。Uta 的胸部还在长，而且她比我还矮……

lines.en: : Would I really...look weird if...
lines.zh: : 我要是……真的会看起来很奇怪吗，如果……

lines.en: : I can’t believe I’m saying this, but let’s stop talking about boobs for a second.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己会说出这话，不过我们能不能先别聊胸部了。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite17
: Hah...{i}Finally{/i}...
scene black
Ami kicks her boots off at the door and tosses her scarf onto the couch, immediately taking a place beside Haruka right after.
lines.zh: Ami 在门口把靴子踢掉，把围巾往沙发上一扔，紧接着就坐到了 Haruka 旁边。

lines.en: Likely to protect me from the allure of her huge boobs.
lines.zh: 大概是为了保护我，不受那对巨乳的诱惑。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite18
: How long is she staying for?
lines.zh: : 她要待多久？

lines.en: : As long as I want. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我想待多久就待多久。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m not asking {i}you{/i}, cafe lady. I’m asking my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 我又没问{i}你{/i}，咖啡馆大姐。我在问我[叔叔]。

lines.en: : As long as she wants.
lines.zh: : 她想待多久就待多久。

lines.en: : And that car parked outside of the house, is {i}that{/i} hers too?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}停在屋外的车，也是她的吗？

lines.en: : Yup! That’s mine.
lines.zh: : 对！是我的。

lines.en: : I’m asking-
lines.zh: : 我在问——

lines.en: : Yes. That is Haruka’s car.
lines.zh: : 是的。那是 Haruka 的车。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite19
: Hah. Owning a car in an urban area like Kumon-mi? Sounds a lot like overcompensation to me.
lines.zh: : 哈。在 Kumon-mi 这种市区里还养车？我听着很像是在过度补偿什么。

lines.en: : Nah. I just had some extra money to spare and needed a way to commute back and forth between {i}my own apartment{/i} and my {i}independently owned business{/i}.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是手头有点余钱，又需要一个往返于{i}我自己的公寓{/i}和{i}我独立经营的店铺{/i}之间的通勤方式。

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I’m perfectly content living with my [uncle] and working part time at a place with super cute outfits instead of ugly green visors.
lines.zh: : 你才是笑话。我跟我[叔叔]住在一起，还在一家有超可爱制服的店里打工，而不是戴那种丑爆的绿色遮阳帽，我可满足了。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite20
: Hey! That shade of green was the result of an informed decision based on years of experience in marketing and service!
lines.zh: : 喂！那种绿色，是我基于多年营销与服务经验做出的明智决定！

lines.en: : Green and brown are earthy colors that create a relaxing atmosphere!
lines.zh: : 绿色和棕色都是大地色系，能营造让人放松的氛围！

lines.en: : Also, your sweater is like the same exact shade of green as the one in the cafe!
lines.zh: : 再说了，你这件毛衣的颜色，跟咖啡馆里那件几乎一模一样！

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite21
: Nuh-uh! How can you even {i}get{/i} a business license if you can’t tell the difference between your ugly shade of green and OLIVE?!
lines.zh: : 才不是！你要是分不出你那丑绿色和橄榄绿的区别，是怎么{i}拿到{/i}营业执照的？！

lines.en: : Wow. You two are getting along even better than I thought you’d be.
lines.zh: : 哇。你俩处得比我想象的还好啊。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite22
: What do you see in this woman, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你看上这个女人哪一点了，Sensei？

lines.en: : If you say my boobs, I’m going to kill you.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢说我的奶子，我就杀了你。

lines.en: : ...I wasn’t going to say that.
lines.zh: : ……我本来也没打算说那个。

lines.en: : I was going to talk about how down to earth and chill you are.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说的是，你有多踏实、多随和。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite23
: Ami, you don’t have to like Haruka, but what will being mean to her do at this point?
lines.zh: : Ami，你不必喜欢 Haruka，可事到如今，对她刻薄又能怎样？

lines.en: : The two of us are already friends, so it’s not like you’re going to get in the middle of that.
lines.zh: : 我们俩已经是朋友了，你也不可能插进来改变这一点。

lines.en: : But if I’m mean to her and make her feel really weird, she won’t want to come back and hang out with you again.
lines.zh: : 可要是我对她很凶，让她觉得很不自在，她就不想再来找你玩了。

lines.en: : She’s got a point. This isn’t very fun.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。这可不太好受。

lines.en: : Yeah, but then that would just mean I’d be going to her place instead. Doesn’t that sound even worse?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那样就只是换成我去她家而已。听起来不是更糟吗？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t...
lines.zh: : 你不会……

lines.en: : I already have.
lines.zh: : 我已经去过了。

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite24
: You have?!
lines.zh: : 你去过？！

lines.en: : Of course. It’s not like I just saw her at the cafe one day and said, “Hey, wanna head back to my place?”
lines.zh: : 当然。我又不是哪天在咖啡馆见到她，就说「嘿，想不想去我家？」

lines.en: : Isn’t that exactly how adults meet each other nowadays?!
lines.zh: : 现在的大人不就是这么认识的吗？！

lines.en: : I mean, that’s {i}kind of{/i} what happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}差不多{/i}就是这么回事。

lines.en: : I gave him my number under the pretense of checking on Rin when she was feeling down, but I really just wanted him to call me so we could get to know each other.
lines.zh: : 我借着「Rin 心情不好，想问问情况」的名义把号码给了他，其实我只是想让他打给我，好让我们彼此了解。

lines.en: : Looks like my plan worked out really well, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我的计划进行得很顺利，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m already meeting the family and everything.
lines.zh: : 我都已经见家长了什么的。

lines.en: : Is there a dog I can pet anywhere? A cat?
lines.zh: : 这附近有狗可以让我摸摸吗？猫也行？

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite25
: Should I just pet this thing instead? She seems kind of feisty.
lines.zh: : 要不我就摸这个算了？她看起来还挺凶的。

lines.en: : She doesn’t bite, does she? Cause if she does, I’ll sue.
lines.zh: : 她不咬人吧？因为她要是咬，我就起诉。

lines.en: : That head is reserved for my [uncle]! I didn’t give you permission to touch me!
lines.zh: : 我的头是留给我的[叔叔]的！我没允许你碰我！

lines.en: : I’m bigger and stronger than you. Try and stop me~
lines.zh: : 我比你大只、比你强壮。有本事拦我呀~

lines.en: scene harukafirstinvite26
: Sensei! Stop her! I’m being sodomized!
lines.zh: : Sensei！拦住她！我在被爆菊！

lines.en: : Where did you even learn that word?
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿学来这个词的？

lines.en: : Please. If I was sodomizing you, {i}you’d know it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 拜托。我要是真在爆你菊，{i}你会知道的{/i}。

lines.en: : Haruka, that’s terrifying.
lines.zh: : Haruka，这话挺吓人的。

lines.en: : What? She started it.
lines.zh: : 怎么？是她先挑起来的。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to enjoy my time as an intruder here since we were so {i}rudely{/i} interrupted.
lines.zh: : 我们被人这么{i}无礼{/i}地打断了，我只是想好好享受一下我这个入侵者在这儿的时间。

lines.en: : I literally live here! Nothing I do is an interruption!
lines.zh: : 我本来就住这儿！我做什么都不算打断！

lines.en: scene black
Haruka and I spend the next couple hours talking in the living room while Ami sits on the couch across from us, staring at her the entire time.
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时里，我和 Haruka 在客厅里聊天，Ami 则坐在对面的沙发上，全程死盯着她。

lines.en: Despite the death glare, however, Haruka remains completely unfazed- which I’m sure makes Ami even angrier.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管被死亡凝视，Haruka 依旧完全不为所动——而这无疑会让 Ami 更生气。

lines.en: I guess there was no way this visit could have ended as successfully as the one with Sara, but it definitely...could have been worse, I guess?...
lines.zh: 我想，这次拜访大概不可能像 Sara 那次一样圆满收场，但它绝对……本来可以更糟吧？……

lines.en: No one died. And that’s really all I can ask for when it comes to things like this.
lines.zh: 没人死。这种事我也就只能要求这么多了。

$ haruka_love += 3
{i}Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Haruka 的好感度提升到了 [haruka_love]!{/i}
